routes.selection: first eligible central-present ROOT CKey, then ordered encoding/index candidates; no later ROOT fallback from missing archive bytes
routes.extent: checked offset plus encoded record size versus held regular-file observed length; not payload acquisition
routes.archive_filename: shared Reader decimal data.NNN convention; hexadecimal formatting must not select another archive
routes.observations: serial metadata observations, not an anchored Linux ancestor lease, atomic snapshot, complete archive hash or remote repair diagnosis

framing.frame_md5: all framed encoded frames, including zero expected MD5, must match
framing.Z: outer mode and framing only; no zlib interior or termination validation
framing.E: outer name-size 0/8, nonce-size 4/8, cipher S and nonempty ciphertext only; no key ID/nonce/bytes returned or interpreted
framing.framed: exact full header/table/extents/EOF and declared-size sum
framing.headerless: HeaderlessUnhashed: no frame hash or table-declared size; Z/E interior termination is not checked
framing.limits: reuse caller-owned existing encoded bytes, decoded declaration and frame-count ceilings
framing.evidence: only copied form, sizes, optional declared size, N/Z/E counts and frame-MD5 count; no digest/raw/plain/cipher bytes

composition.future: retain private selected entry; admit and guarded-read exact full record span, remove known 30-byte local prelude, inspect entire remaining BLTE span, final held/named/store checks on success and error; no prefix or alternative-route fallback

validation.contract_tests: static consistency only; never runtime proof

routes_corrected_linux.scope: synthetic corrected decimal archive naming; Wine runtime remains pending; initial hexadecimal handoff explicitly superseded

real_metadata_observation.scope: Linux build-70205/esES fixed three-FDID metadata-only observation; one Routed candidate each, FitsObservedLength, payload/ciphertext NotInspected
